title: Unity editor icons

tint.label: UI Toolkit
tint.code: image.tintColor = new Color({rf}f, {gf}f, {bf}f);  // UI Toolkit Image: multiplies the icon colour (backgrounds: style.unityBackgroundImageTintColor)

tint.label: IMGUI
tint.code: GUI.contentColor = new Color({rf}f, {gf}f, {bf}f);  // IMGUI: multiplies the icon colour of buttons and labels (GUI.color also tints backgrounds)

snippets.label: IconContent
snippets.note: Returns a GUIContent for IMGUI, e.g. GUILayout.Button(EditorGUIUtility.IconContent("...")) in an editor window or inspector; .image is the Texture2D. In the dark editor theme a plain name returns its d_ version if there is one (checked in the 2022.3 and 6000.3 editors), so use the plain name unless you want one fixed look.

snippets.label: FindTexture
snippets.note: Returns the Texture2D directly. It finds only part of the icons by name (this button is greyed out for the others, use IconContent there).
